title: Tests that reach the bridge must use a temporary registry
trigger: when writing or changing a test that calls MCP tool handlers (retrieve, orient, similar) or hook commands that bridge to the resident
behavior_delta: Call useTempRegistry() from tests/helpers/resident.js at the top of the file (DD_RETRIEVAL=lexical alone is not enough). Without it the test passes while the machine's resident is stale or from another build, and fails as soon as a resident of this build is running, because callRunningStore accepts its answer for the temporary project.
what: Call useTempRegistry() from tests/helpers/resident.js at the top of the file (DD_RETRIEVAL=lexical alone is not enough). Without it the test passes while the machine's resident is stale or from another build, and fails as soon as a resident of this build is running, because callRunningStore accepts its answer for the temporary project.
why: On 2026-09-24 tests/mcp/tools.test.js passed for weeks, then failed right after the resident was restarted from this checkout; the failure left a SQLite store open and npm test hung past 10 minutes instead of reporting it.

evidence_refs.summary: Now calls useTempRegistry so retrieve cannot reach the machine's resident.
callRunningStore takes a reply from any resident of this tree or version recorded in the registry.
Full suite green after the isolation fix.
